subject: game console
title: The 5 Best-Selling Game Consoles Ever, Ranked (#1 Launched in 2000)

scenes.text: The five best-selling game consoles ever. Number one launched in 2000 and still hasn't been caught.

scenes.label: PlayStation 4 · 117.2 million
scenes.text: Number five: the PlayStation 4. 117 million sold from 2013, until Sony stopped reporting the number.

scenes.label: Game Boy · 118.69 million
scenes.text: Number four: the Game Boy. 118.7 million, counting the Game Boy Color. It's from 1989, the oldest machine on this list.

scenes.label: Nintendo DS · 154.02 million
scenes.text: Number three: the Nintendo DS, 154 million. For years it was Nintendo's best seller.

scenes.label: Switch · 156.59 million
scenes.text: Number two: the Nintendo Switch. It passed the DS in early 2026 and reached about 156 million by mid-year.

scenes.label: PlayStation 2 · 160 million
scenes.text: Number one: the PlayStation 2. More than 160 million. A quarter of a century after launch, the Switch is still over three million short.

description:
The five best-selling video game consoles of all time, ranked by lifetime units sold.
The PlayStation 2, launched in 2000, leads with more than 160 million. The Nintendo Switch passed the Nintendo DS (154.02 million) in early 2026 and stood at 156.59 million on 30 June 2026. The Game Boy and Game Boy Color together sold 118.69 million, and the PlayStation 4 finished at 117.2 million. Figures are the makers' own, as of mid-2026.
Will the Switch ever catch the PS2?
first_comment: The Wii just misses the list at 101.63 million. Which console would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
